pr_body:
The promtool check config command still uses the bearer_token_file
field which is deprecated in favour of authorization.credentials_file.

This commit modifies the command to use the new field insted.

Fixes #9874

Signed-off-by: fpetkovski <filip.petkovsky@gmail.com>

issue_context.title: [Promtool] `promtool check config` doesn't properly check `bearer_token_file` file existence
issue_context.body:
**What did you do?**

While working on #5222, I was trying to reproduce the error with `bearer_token_file`. I ran `promtool check config $my_config` against a config file that has `bearer_token_file` set to a path to a file that doesn't exist.

**What did you expect to see?**

Promtool should fail, as it explicitly checks if a file exists for the `bearer_token_file` path.

**What did you see instead? Under which circumstances?**

Promtool check succeeded. During unmarshalling of configs, they'll call `c.HTTPClientConfig.Validate()`. This [validate function moves](https://github.com/prometheus/common/blob/ce7006ede1b27960d267508d7ae0af2f51422610/config/http_config.go#L243-L252) the `bearer_token_file` info to `Authorization.CredentialsFile` and sets `bearer_token_file` to `""`. So when promtool goes to check the config struct, it [only checks the `bearer_token_file`](https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/b48a1e9e9bc3575e2f6ef3e7ea8573434288e0bb/cmd/promtool/main.go#L356-L358) which is set to empty string.

If we want to keep the same functionality, we need to update this check to look at `config.HTTPClientConfig.Authorization.CredentialsFile` instead.

**Environment**

* System information:

Darwin 21.0.1 arm64

* Prometheus version:

prometheus, version 2.32.0-beta.0 (branch: main, revision: 4cae788689121b624557c63d955fbffeef1a91e9)
  build user:       Me
  build date:       20211123-18:19:06
  go version:       go1.17.3
  platform:         darwin/arm64

review_comments: curious if we should have an `else` block that still supports bearer token? Not sure if anyone would still be using that?

common is moving `BearerTokenFile` into `CredentialsFile`, so it's not possible that `BearerTokenFile` is being used.

https://github.com/prometheus/common/blob/ce7006ede1b27960d267508d7ae0af2f51422610/config/http_config.go#L243-L252
